## About
Mirek's European Auto is an independent body and auto repair shop in Oldsmar, in the Tampa Bay area. We handle collision and body work along with mechanical service, so your car can get everything it needs at one shop.
Our teams have worked on German cars for many years, and we focus on European makes like Porsche, Mercedes, Audi, BMW and Volkswagen. If you drive a domestic car, that's no problem either.
When you call, ask for Mirek or Janina. We hold a 4.6 rating from 81 Google reviews.

## Services
- Collision and body work: Body work after an accident or a scrape, handled at our Oldsmar shop.
- Mechanical service: Solid mechanical service alongside our body work.
- European cars: Our specialty is European cars, including Porsche, Mercedes, Audi, BMW and Volkswagen.

## FAQ
Q: Do you only work on European cars?
A: European cars are our specialty, but domestic cars are no problem as well.

Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and closed on Saturday and Sunday.

Q: How do I schedule an appointment?
A: Give us a call at 813-891-9118 and we'll get you on the schedule.
